evidence_and_scope.existing_schema_inspected: Read-only MySQL DESCRIBE transactions on the active Compose database
evidence_and_scope.trigger_evidence: The physical transactions.receipt_id column is INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL with no default, while the approved prompt defines receiptId as integer | null and supplies no receipt field when creating a transaction.
evidence_and_scope.change_required: Allow transactions.receipt_id to be NULL so UC-04 can create a transaction without fabricating a receipt identifier.
out_of_scope: No account, category, user, ownership, relationship, cascade, index, or uniqueness change
No public request or response field change
No backfill or fabricated receipt identifier
No data deletion or Docker volume reset

columns.source_rationale: UC-04 does not accept or create a receipt. The approved prompt explicitly requires the response field to permit null, so inventing a persisted receipt value would violate the source contract.

relationships_and_ownership.statement: The proposal changes only receipt_id nullability. Transaction ownership continues through the selected account and authenticated user.

migration_plan.name: 20260901101931-make-transactions-receipt-id-nullable.ts
forward_operations: Alter transactions.receipt_id from INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL to INT UNSIGNED NULL.
rollback_operations: Refuse rollback while any transactions row has receipt_id IS NULL.
After an explicit data-resolution decision, alter receipt_id back to INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL.
migration_plan.data_loss_risk: The forward migration is non-destructive and does not rewrite existing non-null receipt identifiers. Rollback is blocked after nullable UC-04 rows exist unless the researcher separately resolves those rows.
migration_plan.deployment_considerations: The ALTER may take a metadata or table lock depending on MySQL state and table size. Apply through the existing TypeORM migrations with synchronize=false.

assumptions: The active physical table is lowercase transactions, as confirmed by read-only metadata.
No receipt is created elsewhere in UC-04 and no valid receipt identifier can be derived from the request.
Nullable receipt_id is the smallest schema change compatible with the approved prompt.

approval.approved_via: researcher confirmation in active Codex session
